tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The window's ground: behind the list, the pills, the dialogs, the Activity bar. Seed colour.

tokens.name: card_bg
tokens.usage: The surface of a section's panel and its rows, fields, step cards, the last-run box, the Activity bar's boxes and the rail. Seed colour (`surface`).

tokens.name: card_hover
tokens.usage: A row (or chip, or Activity line) under the pointer. Derived: surface shaded -3% light / +10% dark. Highlights and coloured words are shaded to read on this as well as card_bg.

tokens.name: status_bg
tokens.usage: The status bar along the window's bottom edge. Derived: bg shaded -5% light / +5% dark.

tokens.name: header_bg
tokens.usage: The header bar behind the bolt, the menus and the make buttons. Seed colour. Its words are header_fg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every 1px hairline: a panel's border and the line between its rows, field borders, the splitters, menu borders. Seed colour.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand hue: a script row's 3px rail, + Script and a dialog's default button, a focused field's border, a chosen preset's edge, a menu's highlighted entry. Seed colour.

tokens.name: accent2
tokens.usage: The accent under the pointer, and a focused primary's ring. Derived: accent shaded -15%.

tokens.name: accent_wash
tokens.usage: The chosen row (maximised), the row the keyboard is on, a quiet button's hover and focus, the rail's current place, the chosen preset. Derived: accent shaded +86% light / -55% dark.

tokens.name: bolt
tokens.usage: The brand bolt in the header and on Quick Run; a favourite's star is shaded from it. Fixed across themes -- the identity, not a surface.

tokens.name: bolt_hover
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: name_fg
tokens.usage: Primary text: names, field text, dialog words; also the chosen pill's fill. Reads on bg, card_bg, card_hover and accent_wash.

tokens.name: path_fg
tokens.usage: The theme's muted colour. Painted through muted_fg (paths, hints, captions) and, shaded, as the Stopped outcome word.

tokens.name: fg_on_dark
tokens.usage: Text on the menu ground and a menu's highlighted entry; the seed of header_fg and stop_fg.

tokens.name: fg_on_dark_2
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: tab_fg
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: btn_fg
tokens.usage: The seed of primary_fg, the words on accent-filled buttons.

tokens.name: btn_run_bg
tokens.usage: Run's green circle, the detail pane's Run, Run selected.

tokens.name: btn_run_hover
tokens.usage: Run under the pointer. Derived from btn_run_bg when a theme overrides it.

tokens.name: btn_run_fg
tokens.usage: The play icon on Run's green. Derived: whichever of the light or dark pole measures better against btn_run_bg AND btn_run_hover.

tokens.name: btn_mod_bg
tokens.usage: Only the theme editor's preview swatch. Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: btn_mod_hover
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: btn_create_bg
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: btn_create_hover
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: btn_neutral_bg
tokens.usage: A neutral button's fill (Cancel, Select All, Open output). Derived: surface shaded -6% light / +8% dark.

tokens.name: btn_neutral_hover
tokens.usage: A neutral button under the pointer. Derived: surface shaded -12% light / +14% dark.

tokens.name: btn_neutral_fg
tokens.usage: The seed of neutral_fg, a neutral button's words. Tracks text_muted.

tokens.name: btn_stop_idle
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete. Stop only exists while something runs.

tokens.name: btn_stop_idle_fg
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: btn_stop_active

tokens.name: btn_stop_active_hover

tokens.name: btn_disabled_bg
tokens.usage: A disabled button's fill. Derived: btn_neutral_bg mixed 45% toward card_bg.

tokens.name: btn_disabled_fg
tokens.usage: A disabled control's words, and a disabled menu entry. Derived: dimmed to 2.6:1 -- reads as unavailable without vanishing.

tokens.name: btn_dark_bg
tokens.usage: A button role (`#dark`) no widget uses now. Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: btn_dark_hover
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: tab_inactive_bg
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete. (Its hover twin is drawn.)

tokens.name: tab_inactive_hover

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: The ● OK word (shaded to read: ink-ok), a passed step's chip over the output.

tokens.name: ok_fg
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete. The OK word carries its own shaded ink instead of a filled chip.

tokens.name: running

tokens.name: error

tokens.name: warn_fg

tokens.name: pipe_accent
tokens.usage: A pipeline's 3px rail, the PIPELINE kind word and the SCHEDULED badge (shaded: ink-pipe_accent), the bolt on a pipeline's output tab, a running pipeline's wash.

tokens.name: pipe_accent2
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: out_bg
tokens.usage: The terminal's ground. Fixed across themes by default: a console's look whatever the chrome does.

tokens.name: out_header
tokens.usage: Not painted by the Qt interface; kept so theme files and the theme editor stay complete.

tokens.name: out_tabbar

tokens.name: out_stderr

tokens.name: menu_bg

tokens.name: menu_danger

tokens.name: tooltip_border
tokens.usage: A tooltip's 1px hairline.

tokens.name: primary_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: Words on a filled primary button (+ Script, a dialog's default) -- btn_fg, or black/white where it would not read on accent.

tokens.name: primary_hover_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: The same words on the primary button's hover fill (accent2).

tokens.name: neutral_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: Words on a neutral button (Cancel, Clear history...).

tokens.name: neutral_hover_fg

tokens.name: tooltip_fg

tokens.name: stop_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: Stop's icon and word on its active red fill.

tokens.name: muted_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: Paths, hints, captions, notes: path_fg shaded just enough to read on a row, a hovered row, the window and the chosen row's wash -- kept muted, never black or white.

tokens.name: tab_selected_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: The accent as a word: links (Schedule..., Edit), a row's preset, the output header's words. Held to 3:1 on card_bg and the wash.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Drawn: A favourite's gold star, shaded from bolt until it shows on a row, hovered or chosen.

tokens.name: header_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: Words and menus on the header bar -- fg_on_dark, or dark ink on a pale header_bg.

tokens.name: running_ink
tokens.usage: Drawn: The running list's heading, in the running green, readable on the window.

tokens.name: running_edge
tokens.usage: Drawn: The edge of a running script's row in the running list.

tokens.name: pipe_edge
tokens.usage: Drawn: The edge of a running pipeline's row in the running list.

tokens.name: running_wash
tokens.usage: Drawn: A running script's row fill: the window mixed 16% toward running.

tokens.name: pipe_wash
tokens.usage: Drawn: A running pipeline's row fill: the window mixed 16% toward pipe_accent.

tokens.name: running_name_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: A job's name on either running wash.

tokens.name: running_time_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: A job's elapsed time on either running wash.

tokens.name: step_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: A parallel step's chip over the output, in the terminal's own text colour.

tokens.name: step_fail_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: That chip once its step failed: error, readable on out_bg.

tokens.name: step_ok_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: That chip once its step passed: running green, readable on out_bg.

tokens.name: header_edge
tokens.usage: Drawn: The outline of + Pipeline and + Group on the header: the only thing that says they are buttons, so held to 3:1.

tokens.name: pill_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: The chosen pill's words (group, output, detail and Options tabs): the window colour on a name_fg fill.

tokens.name: pill_idle_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: An unchosen pill's words, on the window and on its hover fill.

tokens.name: pill_edge
tokens.usage: Drawn: An unchosen pill's 1px outline (group, detail, Options and output tabs): the only thing that says it is a button, so held to 3:1 on the window and the hover fill. The chosen pill's edge is its own fill.

tokens.name: control_edge
tokens.usage: Drawn: The 1px outline of fields, neutral buttons, the group picker and preset pills -- in Light the fills alone are 1.01:1 to the window.

tokens.name: focus_edge
tokens.usage: Drawn: The 2px outline round the row the keyboard is on (and a focused chip's edge): the accent, shaded to 3:1 against the row's wash and the rows around it.

tokens.name: badge_fg
tokens.usage: Drawn: The running count on the rail's Activity button, on the running fill.

tokens.name: ink-pipe_accent

color.note: Eight of the thirteen palettes RYOS ships. Light and Dark are hand-tuned and used verbatim; the other six are expanded from a 7-colour seed by build_palette() in ryos/themes.py, so their derived values are exactly what the app paints.

type.note: Two OS families, no webfonts: RYOS is a Qt desktop app and asks the platform for Segoe UI and Consolas by name. Six sizes, set in points in ryos/qtui/stylesheet.py (10pt is the base every widget inherits); px below are those points at 96 dpi.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The chosen item's name in the maximised detail pane (16pt bold). The largest type in the app.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The header's RYOS wordmark, beside the drawn bolt (13pt bold).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A row's name (11pt bold; 10pt semibold on a compact row).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The base: menus, fields, buttons, dialog labels, pills (10pt; pills and buttons semibold).

styles.name: secondary
styles.usage: A row's path and outcome word, facts in the detail pane, hints under fields, the status bar (9pt).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Section headings, a row's kind (PYTHON, PIPELINE), badges, the detail pane's headings (8pt bold, capitals).

styles.name: terminal
styles.usage: The output panel and run history (Consolas 10).

styles.name: terminal-small
styles.usage: Parameters shown as values: a row's preset chip, the detail pane's preset chips (Consolas 9).

spacing.note: Qt layout margins and stylesheet padding as the code sets them (ryos/qtui/*, cardstyle.CARD_PADDING). Not a strict grid: these are the steps in use, ordered by size.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's name line and its path line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: A favourite chip's vertical padding; an output tab pill's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between header buttons and between group pills.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's buttons and between favourite chips; a menu item's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's kind, name and outcome; between the search box and the pills.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: A row's vertical padding at medium size; the top of the list area.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: A row's horizontal padding at every size; a menu icon's inset; a chip's horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: The list's side margin -- the search box, pills and panels line up on it; a pill's horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: A menu item's gap on the right; the menu words start 36px in (the icon column).

tokens.name: space-26
tokens.usage: The detail pane's side margin, maximised.

radius.note: RYOS is near-square, with one exception: things you choose or press on their own are pills. No shadows; separation comes from a hairline, a fill or the rail.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: A section's panel (its rows share it), the update banner, the quiet buttons' hover box.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Text fields, drop-downs, spin boxes, dialog buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Half the height: group pills, output tab pills, favourite chips, preset chips -- and Run, a circle.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The header bar, section headings, rows inside a panel, the output panel.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The application icon's rounded rectangle only (make_icon.py). Not a UI value.

size.note: Line weights and fixed sizes, in px.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: A panel's border and the line between its rows; field and tooltip borders; a neutral button's focus edge.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The strip down a row's left edge: accent on a script, pipe_accent on a pipeline.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on Run (in name_fg, on any fill). Quiet buttons show focus with the accent wash instead.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: The smallest thing you can click (WCAG 2.5.8): chip Run, preset chip, Quick Run, tab close.

tokens.name: run
tokens.usage: Run's diameter on a row; 26px on a compact row, 24px on a favourite chip.

tokens.name: button-cell
tokens.usage: The width of each of a row's quiet buttons, so script and pipeline rows line up.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: The usual icon size; drawn on a 24-unit grid with a 2-unit stroke (ryos/qtui/icons.py).
